scope: Remove artificial lifetime history admission caps and duplicate same-invocation owner authentication; retain exact live authority and full immutable history.
riskAnalysis: Removing historical cardinality caps does not grant execution. Full historical validation and actual provider errors remain authoritative. Fresh single-use authority proof eliminates only duplicate production-equivalent authentication within a read; forged or stale proofs deny.

threatModel.assets: Historical audit records, revoked authority, owner/workspace isolation, exact source and release, and current execution controls.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Fresh authenticated operations read mints module-private one-use proof; controller checks exact context; broker rechecks live ledger; cleanup scans complete historical collections.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged or reused owner proof; changed identity during awaits; hidden late active record; invalid null-limit arithmetic; history truncation; concurrent append; foreign history disclosure.
threatModel.mitigations: Opaque per-call request/service/view/identity/runtime binding, preawait identity capture, fallback fresh authentication, full hash-chain and history readback, CAS, scoped redaction, late-record and provider-failure adversarial tests.

rollback: Revert only reviewed successor source on feature branch; preserve all historical records and consumed approvals. Never truncate rows to fit an older application cap; keep paid disabled pending compatible recovery.

defects.rootCause: Every activation subject invocation authenticated the same owner twice serially before its ledger phase, contributing avoidable latency to observed renewal timeout.
defects.detectionGap: Previous controller fixtures tested denial and renewal separately but did not prove single fresh production-equivalent authentication per subject invocation.
defects.regression: Seventy-six affected checks include branded read, forged reader fallback, proof misuse, TOCTOU, revocation and scaled delayed-owner reproduction.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep one-use proof scoped to exact invocation and include latency plus forged-reader cases when modifying authentication wiring.

defects.rootCause: Historical cardinality ceilings blocked admission despite available provider resources, and cleanup projections silently sliced the first128 records.
defects.detectionGap: Prior cleanup tests stayed below historical collection ceilings and did not exercise late owned or foreign records.
defects.regression: Append and concurrent prefix preservation beyond old counts; late active/foreign/malformed records; full cleanup candidate visibility and actual provider-error preservation.
defects.historicalPrevention: Separate lifetime utilization telemetry from live resource/authority limits; test entire historical readback rather than only initial prefixes.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing controller, operations store, lifecycle and organization ledger extended; no competing system or authorization identity.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new dependencies, credentials, services or infrastructure.
proactiveReview.threats: Authentication proof forgery or reuse; collection shape corruption; late authority hidden by projection; provider failure.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unknown or revoked authority denies; malformed late records block; provider failures propagate without truncating history.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Identity/runtime mutation during await, forged and copied proof, late active records, concurrent writes and unavailable provider.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate child implementation authors and Work QA; root independently reviewed proof; different child Auditor independently reviewed cap changes.
proactiveReview.recovery: Prior consumed trial unchanged; no paid retry; new exact qualified successor requires fresh configuration and execution grant.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused verification and independent reviews passed; remote STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL, Jekyll and actual Preview Browser evidence required before paid dispatch.
